scripts.setup: python -m pip install -r packages/api/requirements.txt && npm --prefix packages/frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api "npm --prefix packages/frontend run dev" "cd packages/api && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 5000"
scripts.test:db: bash packages/db/reset_db.sh gov_test && psql -d gov_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f packages/db/tests/governance_tests.sql
scripts.test:concurrency: bash packages/db/reset_db.sh conc_test && python packages/db/tests/concurrency_test.py conc_test
scripts.test:api: npm run db:reset && cd packages/api && python -m pytest tests -q
